requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Minnesota county of the case, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Minnesota county of the case, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county where the case was, from your court records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court file number, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court file number, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court file number, from Minnesota Court Records Online or the court's own papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the case ended (the disposition), in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the case ended (the disposition), in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the disposition, exactly as the court record states it, checked against your BCA record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The requester's own statement of why they are asking, in paragraph 3 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The requester's own statement of why they are asking, in paragraph 3 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform prints the participant's own account and writes none of it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own words: why you are asking the prosecutor to agree - these lines are yours alone

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Prosecuted by - the county attorney, or which city attorney - in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Prosecuted by - the county attorney, or which city attorney - in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which authority prosecuted lives on the record, not in the platform
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: whether the county attorney or a city attorney prosecuted, from the court papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Office name and mailing address of the prosecuting authority, in the addressee block of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Office name and mailing address of the prosecuting authority, in the addressee block of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which authority prosecuted and where it receives mail varies by county and city; no directory is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county attorney or city attorney that prosecuted the case, and that office's mailing address - the Minnesota Attorney General's expungement page is the statewide entry point for identifying it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The Sec. 609A.02, subd. 3 ground the requester believes applies, and why, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The Sec. 609A.02, subd. 3 ground the requester believes applies, and why, in paragraph 2 of the request
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which statutory ground fits is a judgment about the participant's own record that the platform does not make
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which subd. 3 ground you believe applies and why - the statute's own grounds list is where to look, and a lawyer or legal-aid office is the place to take a doubtful one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The participant's own list of attached rehabilitation material
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The participant's own list of attached rehabilitation material
requiredBeforeFiling.why: rehabilitation material is participant-authored; the packet formats it and does not assess it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own list, in your own hand, of the material you are attaching - programmes completed, work history, education, community involvement - with the documents themselves behind this page

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the written request
protectedBlanks.why: the request is the participant's own; the participant signs it personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the written request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the request is signed would be false
